race.description: The Club Country Cups Challenge Qualifier Roma Cup Qlty Hcp
race.comment: FIRE AND LIGHT (6) looks strong after a dominant BM62 win at Toowoomba over 1625m, where he sprinted clear to win by over five lengths despite being held up near the 300m. The Open grade is a tougher challenge, but he has won at this track and distance, and the quick back-up is a plus. CARDIOLOGIST (5) poses a significant threat after securing victory as favourite in Charleville, boasting two wins and one placing from five attempts at this distance, along with a solid record with Isabel Jessop. ROCK THE SUNRISE (7) has been consistent this season, winning a BM70 at Ewan and finishing second to Brave Agenda at Townsville as a popular choice. Can play a leading role. VILLADEN (2) let down as favourite at Kumbia, yet his earlier second at Tara was solid. Not to be discounted. TURNSTAR (3) can feature in the finish.
